prose: Figure announces the decommission of its F.02 robot fleet as the F.03 fleet grows. F.02 had firsts including a BMW deployment, Helix and household chores. Disassembling robots full of proprietary actuators would delay the F.04 launch, so the company asked the internet what to do.
highlights: F.02 fleet retired as F.03 grows.
Proprietary hardware must be protected on disposal.
